title: Critical surface for two component Bose-Einstein Condensates
summary: We investigate the existence of ground states for two-component Bose--Einstein condensates with intraspecies interactions $a_1, a_2 \in (0, a^*)$ and interspecies interaction $β>0$. By carefully investigating an associated auxiliary minimization problem, we prove the existence of a unique, continuous, critical surface $γ= γ(a_1, a_2)$ between $β_*:= \sqrt{(a^* - a_1) (a^* - a_2)}$ and $β^*:= a^* - \frac{a_1 + a_2}{2}$.
